rows.title: Spring Boot binds no property spring.datasource.hikari.max-pool-size
rows.detail: No Spring Boot, Spring Cloud or starter jar this project resolves documents it, and no @ConfigurationProperties or @Value in the project reads it. A typo, or a property from another version, does nothing; if the code reads it some other way (Environment.getProperty), dismiss it.
rows.fix: Check the spelling against the Spring Boot reference, or remove it.
